responsibility: This grammar/action source defines mc parser pass 2, the stage that revisits the token stream to resolve type equivalence structure and enumeration declarations. Its semantic actions build type aliases, enumeration nodes and fields, definition-module qualified type references, and mark enum processing complete for a module, producing richer type information on top of the pass-1 symbol skeleton.
same_name_distinction: This .bnf file is the grammar/action source for parser pass 2 in the mcp2 stem, with productions and actions that resolve definition-module-qualified types, build enums and enum fields, and mark enum processing complete; mcp2.def merely declares the parser entry point.
